draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click. On your two open notes: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and on the 429s -- API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter. I'll keep both tickets moving.

One thing that tends to help at this stage: getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
